_about: Ranking Decision Engine rules (PRISM v0.4 §8.2). Edit numbers here; the engine shows which rule fired.
_pool_scope: 'country' compares people only with the same role in the same country (pay, targets and exit law differ). 'together' pools India and China for each role; each person still gets their own country's bottom-tier step.

bottom_tier_action.IN: Documented improvement plan (PIP); worker vs non-worker rules differ
bottom_tier_action.CN: Training or reassignment first; a low rank alone is never an exit ground (LCL Art. 40(2), SPC Guiding Case No. 18)
